notes:
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited only after saving, not before.
REF-BM-04: URL editing is unsupported, and the UI can add but not remove tags.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including the quote characters.
REF-BM-20: Bulk add-tag, archive, and delete exist, but remove-tag and read/unread actions do not.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting every bookmark in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is not rendered.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are not implemented.
